RTL = H-DIE structural rewrite (main 7a8b12424 / d93f7f06d: GF products as module instances). Outline sized from the H-DIE SerDes SYNTH (enc ~15.4k um2 std incl. gmul cells) + recipe-3 pin registers at ~62% util. S-DIE serdes/ucie macro boundary (physical/asap7_v41x_pdie_macros_v2/ot_pdie_serdes.lef, 250.056 x 2250.216 W/E link column, R0 = west column): PMA lanes / pads on the W (die-edge) face, the core-side beat bus on the E face (east column = MY mirror). tx_v/tx_d/fault/clk/rst_n on E (core side, ck domain), p_v/p_d on W (to the PMA TX).

job.purpose: S81 link KP4 encoder leaf (one per SerDes link macro), never kitted before (census 10-16). Bench = H-DIE KP4_GATE configuration base (16/16 parity exact vs rs544.py, 119 frames exact, beyond-t flagged) and its encoder mutant EMUT1.
